mapper.select: WITH base AS (SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.confirmed_at AS confirmed_at, i.sku_id AS sku_id, i.sale_unit_snapshot AS unit, i.ordered_quantity AS ordered_quantity, i.sku_code_snapshot AS sku_code, i.product_name_snapshot AS product_name, i.spec_name_snapshot AS spec_name, i.locked_unit_price AS locked_unit_price FROM sales_order o JOIN sales_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.deleted = FALSE WHERE o.deleted = FALSE AND o.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND o.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.confirmed_at >= #{since}), agg AS (SELECT sku_id, unit, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count, SUM(ordered_quantity) AS ordered_quantity, MAX(confirmed_at) AS last_confirmed_at FROM base GROUP BY sku_id, unit), latest AS (SELECT sku_id, unit, sku_code, product_name, spec_name, locked_unit_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sku_id, unit ORDER BY confirmed_at DESC, order_id DESC) AS rn FROM base) SELECT a.sku_id AS sku_id, l.sku_code AS sku_code, l.product_name AS product_name, l.spec_name AS spec_name, a.unit AS unit, a.order_count AS order_count, a.ordered_quantity AS ordered_quantity, a.last_confirmed_at AS last_confirmed_at, l.locked_unit_price AS recent_unit_price FROM agg a JOIN latest l ON l.sku_id = a.sku_id AND l.unit = a.unit AND l.rn = 1 ORDER BY a.order_count DESC, a.last_confirmed_at DESC, a.sku_id LIMIT #{limit}
